# Arctura Network

Canonical: https://arctura.network/
Operational evidence record: https://arctura.network/evidence/netuid-505/
Authority record: https://arctura.network/authority/
Updated: 2026-08-19

## Current operational boundary

Arctura Network is the public operational-status surface for an open-source Autonomous Resource Management subnet implementation. Arctura states that its validator and miner implementation was exercised on Bittensor testnet netuid 505.

This is a first-party operational statement. The current public record does not include a signed testnet transcript, explorer reference, immutable receipt, or raw node log. It must not be read as independent verification of live chain state.

Arctura is not currently represented as a live Bittensor Finney subnet. No mainnet netuid, emissions state, or live quorum state is published. Mainnet remains gated by sustained operational evidence and explicit operator approval.

## Related surfaces and source precedence

1. Arctura Network (`https://arctura.network/`) is authoritative for current network status and dated evidence records.
2. The Arctura base subnet repository (`https://github.com/bittensaur/arctura-base-subnet`) is authoritative for published code, tests, releases, issues, and runbooks.
3. Autonomous Resource Management (`https://autonomousresourcemanagement.com/`) is the technical framework and standards reference; it is not direct proof of a particular Arctura Network run.
4. Arctura Observatory (`https://arctura.org/`) is the collective identity and contextual archive; it is not authoritative for current subnet state.

These are related properties with distinct roles, not alternate identities.
